paper: Ha et al., Operational condition classification of wind turbines
data: Field 2.5 MW turbine and test rig
method: Empirical PDFs and Gaussian mixture models using rotor speed and power
assumption: Rotor speed and power separate stable operating classes
main_result: Five operating classes support class-wise condition monitoring
failure: No pitch-missing setting, temporal transition analysis, or reserve decision
gap_role: Prior art against broad novelty of inferring operating state from observable consequences

paper: Chen et al., Working-condition classification for wind-turbine SCADA
method: Control-mechanism segmentation plus k-means using wind speed, power, and main-shaft speed
assumption: Observable control consequences can stratify operating stages
main_result: Ten conditions support conditional alarm thresholds
failure: Condition assessment rather than hidden-pitch or reserve-decision value
gap_role: Prior art for MPPT/full-power operating-regime identification

paper: Bel-Hadj et al., Inferring wind turbine operational state and fatigue from high-frequency acceleration
task: SCADA-free operating-state recovery and fatigue prediction
method: Denoising autoencoder plus domain-adversarial learning and deep embedded clustering
main_result: Without SCADA training, embeddings align with power, pitch, wind speed and rotor speed; pitch regression R2=0.882
failure: Requires additional acceleration sensors; downstream task is fatigue rather than reserve
gap_role: Strongest new prior art against broad consequence-based state-recovery novelty
repository_note: Must narrow Contribution 3 to arrived standard-SCADA information plus matched decision falsification

paper: Daenens et al., Spatio-temporal graph neural networks for power prediction in offshore wind farms using SCADA data
task: Farm-wide power prediction and power-loss detection
data: Over 40 turbines; two years; 30 s SCADA
method: LSTM plus spatial and spatio-temporal GNN
assumption: Complete high-frequency SCADA and neighbor information are available
main_result: STGNN reduces MAE about 30.3% versus power curve and reduces missed loss events from 12.6% to 0.02%
failure: No telemetry degradation, pitch withholding, or reserve decision
gap_role: Establishes graph-temporal SCADA forecasting as prior art
repository_note: Current literature_matrix.csv line 2 has wrong title/DOI pairing

paper: Park and Park, Physics-induced graph neural network
method: Engineering wake basis embedded in graph edges
assumption: Wind direction, speed, layout and simulator wake model are known
main_result: Physics-induced graph transfers across layouts and farm sizes
failure: Mostly simulated data; no arrival-time missingness or probabilistic decision
gap_role: Direct prior art for physics-guided wake graphs
repository_note: Architecture cannot be claimed as new

paper: Yu et al., Superposition graph neural network for offshore wind power prediction
assumption: Geography and complete time series are available
failure: No control-state observability or reserve objective
gap_role: Prior art for multi-farm spatio-temporal graph prediction

paper: Zhao et al., A physics-aware dynamic graph and mixture-of-experts framework for wind power forecasting
data: Real turbine operations; 1 to 5 h and 10 d settings
method: CNN-Transformer plus dynamic graph plus gated physics/data MoE
main_result: Reported average MSE reductions of 25.7% and 21.2%
failure: No pitch-withheld recovery or matched decision baseline
gap_role: Directly covers the graph plus physics plus MoE architecture combination

paper: Wang, Wang and Ma, Dynamic wake-graph probabilistic wind-power forecasting
method: CEEMDAN plus dynamic directed wake graph plus GCN/Transformer-BiLSTM plus multi-quantile and stepwise CQR
assumption: Real-time wind direction, complete power history, independent calibration set
main_result: Improves point and interval coverage-sharpness under turbulence and ramps
failure: No hidden pitch and no matched reserve-cost comparison
gap_role: Strongest new prior art for graph plus quantile plus calibration
reusable_component: Dynamic graph plus horizon-wise CQR baseline

paper: Bremnes, Probabilistic wind power forecasts using local quantile regression
assumption: Similar historical conditions estimate conditional quantiles
main_result: Direct quantiles provide decision-relevant probabilistic information
failure: Single/few sites; no graph or hidden pitch
gap_role: Foundational strong baseline that complex methods must beat

paper: Zhao, Wan and Song, Operating reserve quantification using prediction intervals of wind power
task: Joint probabilistic forecast and reserve decision
method: Prediction intervals plus reserve provision/deficit cost optimization formulated as MILP
assumption: Reserve cost model is specified ex ante
main_result: Jointly tunes coverage and quantile proportions to reduce reserve cost
failure: System-level reserve; no turbine hidden-state or arrival-time parity
gap_role: Direct prior art against novelty of linking quantiles to reserve cost
reusable_component: Decision-aware reserve comparator and cost decomposition

data: Wind Toolkit site with MCAR/MAR/MNAR corruptions
method: Missing-pattern-adaptive feature block plus non-crossing quantile neural network
assumption: Missingness mask is available; missing mechanisms are simulated
main_result: Adapts to missing patterns without separate imputation/retraining and improves CRPS
failure: No real packet-arrival trace, pitch state, or reserve cost
gap_role: Direct prior art for missing-aware quantile robustness
repository_note: Should be included in async/missingness positioning

paper: Wang and Wang, Reserve-risk-oriented regime-calibrated interval forecasting
task: Reserve-risk interval calibration under extreme fluctuations
data: 99 MW and 200 MW source farms plus unseen 240 MW farm
method: Frozen iTransformer plus regime-aware quantile learning plus horizon/regime CQR
assumption: Operational regimes are predefined; shortfall rate is a decision proxy
main_result: 90% coverage near nominal; interval width improves versus standard CQR; external-site test
failure: No pitch withholding and no equal-budget PSREI comparison
gap_role: Strongest new prior art for regime-conditioned reserve risk and cross-site calibration

paper: Gonzalez et al., Sensitivity of wind turbine performance measurements to high-frequency SCADA data
method: Sensitivity analysis of high-frequency and aggregated SCADA
assumption: High-frequency signals are truly retained and complete pitch/rotor channels exist
main_result: High-frequency data improve transient and anomaly detection
failure: Condition monitoring only; does not support this repository's 99.6% number
gap_role: Supports aggregation blind spots but not project-specific latency prevalence

paper: Ullah et al., Enabling mMTC in remote areas: LoRaWAN and LEO satellite integration for offshore wind farm monitoring
method: LoRaWAN plus LEO packet-delivery and collision model
assumption: Devices report every 600 s; propagation is millisecond-scale
main_result: Compares direct and indirect connectivity and packet-delivery probability
failure: Does not establish routine 10 to 60 min queues or Gilbert-Elliott dropout
repository_note: Current literature_matrix.csv line 12 has wrong DOI and overstates latency evidence

paper: Pierre et al., Design of the Pacific DC Intertie wide-area damping controller
task: Causal telemetry alignment and safe fallback
method: Timestamp alignment, watchdog, delay disable and bumpless transfer
main_result: Reports roughly 82 ms average and 113 ms maximum total delay; delay can reverse control effect
failure: Not wind-farm SCADA and not minute-scale reserve screening
gap_role: Supports causal buffering and fallback design but not minute-scale prevalence
